meta_desc: Pinnacle EDS designs and implements the clinical, educational, and policy systems that health systems, school districts, and governments use to deliver consistent special education and ABA services.
og_desc: Clinical, educational, and policy systems for institutions delivering special education at scale.
hero_h1: Special education can't scale without structure.
hero_lede: We design and implement the clinical, educational, and policy systems that health systems, school districts, and governments use to deliver consistent care, at any scale.
serve_h2: Systems, not advice, for organizations operating at scale.
serve_lede: Our work is built for institutions where consistency across sites, schools, or an entire country determines whether a child receives quality care.
t1_p: Standardized ABA and special education clinical infrastructure across every location, from treatment planning to supervision and documentation.
t2_p: Program design, IEP infrastructure, compliance frameworks, and educator workforce development for large public systems.
t3_p: National policy frameworks, workforce pipelines, and implementation for governments building or reforming special education, including across the Gulf region.
appr_h2: From assessment to independence, in five phases.
appr_lede: Every engagement follows the same disciplined path and ends with infrastructure your teams can run without us.
s1_p: Audit of current systems, compliance posture, and gaps, with a prioritized roadmap.
s2_p: Frameworks, clinical standards, and policy documents built for your scale.
s3_p: Hands-on rollout across your organization or ministry.
s4_p: Workforce development so your teams operate the system independently.
s5_p: Advisory, compliance monitoring, and system evolution over time.
appr_note: All engagements are governed by our Institutional Implementation Methodology (IIM), which defines phased delivery, governance, risk management, and long-term sustainability.
fw_lede: Each framework is a defined engagement built from our team's clinical and educational leadership experience.
g1_sub: For health systems and multi-site ABA providers.
g2_sub: For state agencies, districts, and training pipelines.
cia_d: An organizational audit of program design, documentation, scheduling, supervision, and compliance.
isf_d: Consistent treatment plan development, goal architecture, and program design across every clinician and location.
sds_d: A scheduling and delivery method that targets, tracks, and executes clinical goals within every session.
mqas_d: Standardized documentation, supervisory review, and clinical auditing across locations and jurisdictions.
sesra_d: Evaluation of infrastructure, workforce capacity, and compliance alignment ahead of systemic reform.
nwdf_d: Training pipelines from foundational educator competencies to advanced practitioner and train-the-trainer programs.
grpa_d: Review of policy, infrastructure gaps, and workforce readiness, with a pathway to national implementation.
lead_h2: Founded by practitioners who have run these systems.

lead_p2: Together the team brings more than 80 years of experience, including 30+ years in executive education leadership.

a11y_meta: Accessibility commitment and contact information for Pinnacle EDS.

a11y_li1: Every page can be used with a keyboard alone, with visible focus indicators.
a11y_li2: Pages use headings and landmarks so screen reader users can navigate easily.
a11y_li3: Text and controls meet minimum color contrast ratios, and text can be enlarged without losing content.
a11y_li4: Images have text alternatives, and forms have clear labels and messages.
a11y_li5: The site is offered in several languages, with a right-to-left layout for Arabic.

pr_h2: What we build. How we deliver.
pr_lede: We are a firm built on delivery discipline, not vague advice. Every engagement holds to the same five commitments.
pr1_p: Every system we design meets the compliance, documentation, and governance standards expected at the institutional level.
pr2_p: Evidence-based frameworks built to perform consistently across sites, schools, and teams.
pr3_p: Ready-to-deploy tools and frameworks built for real implementation, not long planning cycles.
pr4_p: Deep awareness of the regulatory, cultural, and institutional context of every setting we work in, in the United States and abroad.
pr5_p: Every system is designed to run without us. Your organization's independence is built in from day one.
ac_h2: Accountability built in, not bolted on.
ac_lede: Every system we deliver includes the structures that show it is working, and keep it working after we leave.
ac1_p: Shared templates and rules so every clinician and school records care the same way.
ac2_p: Defined review cycles so supervisors catch gaps early and respond consistently.
ac3_p: Structured audits across sites and jurisdictions, using the same criteria every time.
ac4_p: Clear indicators and reports aligned to what your board, agency, or ministry expects.
ac5_p: Training pathways and competency checks so quality never depends on one person.
ac6_p: Systems mapped to federal, state, and national requirements, with local counsel where needed.
faq_lede: Short answers to what organizations and ministries ask us first. Have another question?
faq1_a: We design and implement the clinical, educational, and policy systems that institutions use to deliver special education and ABA services consistently. That includes assessments, frameworks, quality and documentation systems, and the training your teams need to run them.
faq2_a: Health systems and multi-site ABA providers, state education agencies and large school districts, and governments and ministries of education.
faq3_a: Every engagement moves through five phases: assessment, system design, implementation, training, and ongoing support. It is governed by our Institutional Implementation Methodology and designed so your teams can run the system without us.
faq4_q: Do you work outside the United States?
faq4_a: Yes. We work virtually and on site, including with governments in the Gulf region and the wider Middle East and North Africa. When local legal or regulatory interpretation is needed, we coordinate with qualified counsel in that jurisdiction.
faq5_q: Do you provide therapy or services directly to children?
faq5_a: No. We provide consulting and systems design for organizations. Clinical and educational recommendations are carried out by your own appropriately licensed professionals.
faq6_a: Our practitioners hold Licensed Behavior Analyst credentials in Minnesota, Virginia, Kansas, Maryland, and Hawaii, and teaching licensure in California, Minnesota, and Hawaii.
faq7_a: Send us a message or email info@pinnacleeds.com, and we will reply to schedule a discovery call. Ministries, please include your country and ministry.
about_meta: Who we are, why Pinnacle EDS exists, and the managing directors who lead it: Emily Freeman, BCBA, and Ahmed Elmi.
ab_h1: Built by demand. Focused on impact.
ab_lede: Pinnacle EDS was established in 2026 by practitioners who had spent years being sought out by organizations, districts, and agencies that needed their expertise.
ab_story_h2: One firm for work its founders were already doing.
ab_story_p1: After years of being pulled toward this work while serving in other roles, our founders came together with a single mandate: build the firm that could deliver what they had each been doing for decades, with the scale and structure institutions need.
ab_story_p2: Large organizations and governments set the conditions for whether children receive quality special education. When those systems are well built, children thrive. When they are fragmented or missing, children fall through the gaps. Our work exists to close those gaps at the institutional level, where the most children can be reached.
ab_quote: Every child, wherever they live or go to school, deserves a system built to serve them.
ab_mis_h2: Systems that serve children, families, and communities.
m1_p: Consistent, evidence-based ABA and special education services, whichever school, clinic, or country a child is in.
m2_p: Transparency, consistency, and confidence in the care their children receive, with the support they need alongside it.
m3_p: Governance that keeps quality consistent across every school in a nation, so geography never decides whether a child is served.
ab_lead_lede: Our managing directors lead a broader team of credentialed practitioners, educators, and institutional specialists.
emily_p1: My career in special education spans more than 17 years, and in that time I have worked at every level of the system — from direct service with students who have the most complex needs, to district-level leadership shaping how entire school systems deliver behavioral and special education support. That range of experience is what drives my work at Pinnacle EDS: I understand not just the clinical science, but the institutional realities that determine whether good practice actually reaches students.
emily_p2: For over a decade, I served as a lead behavior specialist with the Hawaii Department of Education at the district level, where I was responsible for designing, implementing, and overseeing behavioral support systems across schools. That role required me to work at the intersection of policy, practice, and people — translating research into training, coaching educators at scale, and building accountability structures that held up under real-world conditions. It is the kind of systems-level work that most clinicians never get the opportunity to do, and it fundamentally shaped how I think about what effective special education looks like.
ahmed_p1: With more than 30 years of experience in education leadership, I have built my career around one central belief: that every student deserves a system designed to help them succeed. My work has spanned public school districts, higher education, and school leadership — giving me a deep, ground-level understanding of how educational institutions function, where they struggle, and what it takes to transform them at scale.
ahmed_p2: My career began in the Minneapolis and Saint Paul Public School systems, where I worked across roles that shaped my understanding of urban education, equity, and the operational realities facing administrators and educators every day. Over the years, I have led initiatives focused on school improvement, student achievement, workforce development, and institutional accountability — always with an eye toward building systems that are not just effective today, but sustainable for years to come.
ab_exp_lede: Selected experience from our leadership team's prior roles, the foundation our frameworks and methodology are built on.
x1_b1: Designed and implemented center-wide treatment plan standardization across multiple clinic locations.
x1_b2: Built clinical scheduling infrastructure for consistent goal delivery in every session.
x1_b3: Developed supervisory review and documentation quality systems adopted organization-wide.
x1_b4: Led clinical staff training and BCBA onboarding program development.
x2_meta: Prior executive leadership role · Multiple schools
x2_b1: Served as executive director overseeing special education programs across multiple schools.
x2_b2: Designed and implemented district-wide IEP frameworks and compliance systems.
x2_b3: Built educator workforce development programs aligned to state and federal requirements.
x2_b4: Led trauma-informed practice integration across school special education programs.
x3_meta: Prior clinical leadership role · Multiple states
x3_b1: Developed and implemented ABA programming in school settings across multiple states.
x3_b2: Designed behavior intervention systems integrated with school-wide positive behavior frameworks.
x3_b3: Provided clinical supervision and ABA training to educational staff.
x3_b4: Built compliance documentation systems aligned to state education regulations.
ab_cred_lede: Our teams hold the credentials and state licensure needed to work across the clinical, educational, and institutional settings we serve.
ab_team_note: We deploy multidisciplinary teams of behavior analysts, special education specialists, education leaders, and implementation professionals, virtually and on site. When local legal or regulatory interpretation is needed, we coordinate with qualified counsel in that jurisdiction.
emily_p3: I hold a Master of Education in Special Education with a specialization in Severe and Profound Disabilities and Autism from the University of Hawaii — one of the most rigorous and respected programs in the field — and a Bachelor of Science from Western Washington University. I am a Board Certified Behavior Analyst and hold licensure as a Licensed Behavior Analyst in both Minnesota and Hawaii.
emily_p4: At Pinnacle EDS, I lead our clinical systems practice, helping education systems design and implement the structures, training, and oversight needed to deliver high-quality behavioral and special education support at scale.
ahmed_creds: M.Ed., MBA · 30+ years in education leadership
ahmed_p3: My academic foundation reflects the breadth of my professional focus. I hold a Master of Education in English as a Second Language from Hamline University, a second Master of Education from California State University, Fresno, and a Master of Business Administration from the State University of New York at Albany. I also completed a Certificate of Leadership at Harvard University — an experience that sharpened my approach to organizational leadership, strategic decision-making, and leading complex institutions through change.
ahmed_p4: At Pinnacle EDS, I lead our education and institutional affairs practice, working directly with governments, ministries of education, and school systems to assess where they are, design where they need to go, and build the infrastructure to get there.
